Hi Vanessa / Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week — CloudBridge is excited to move to a technical deep-dive to align on marketplace integration and deployment patterns. We think a 90-minute joint solution workshop (CloudBridge SI + Redwood infra/solutions) will be ideal to cover:

- High-level integration flow (auth, routing, telemetry)
- Marketplace packaging & publish checklist
- Deployment topology options (VPC, private, dedicated)
- Performance expectations and benchmarking plan
- Action items & mutual owners

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue April 13 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed April 14 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu April 15 — 08:30–10:00 PT (shorter)

Attached is a draft agenda (redwood-cloudbridge-workshop-agenda.docx) and a one-page summary of our integration goals. Please let me know which slot works best and who from Redwood would lead the architecture walkthrough.

Thanks,
